tour.badge: A rikma is a collaboration group - everyone contributes their skills and earns according to their contribution
tour.tools:
The rikma's tools:
• Public profile - the page everyone sees
• Address & look - the address and design of the public page
• Edit details (the pencil) - name, description, links and rikma settings
If the rikma has social links (Discord, WhatsApp, website...), they appear here too
tour.members: Rikma members - a pulsing green ring around a photo means that partner is working for the rikma right now. Click a photo to open their profile
tour.create:
➕ Create: add missions and request resources (money, gear, info) - for the current partners, or to find new ones. Every published mission or resource gets its own beautiful share page, made for social networks
🤖 You can also let AI create missions automatically: write where you want the rikma to grow and it breaks that into missions, or let it scan the rikma and spot what it needs on its own. Nothing is created until you approve
tour.nav: The menu has six groups. Clicking a group opens a row of tabs under it, and the brain remembers which tab you were on in each group

group.main:
🏠 Main
• Main - the rikma at a glance
• Shared info - the rikma's library: documents, files and links every partner needs
group.work:
🛠️ Work
• Progress - the active missions: who is working on what, and at which stage
• Acts - the small tasks inside the missions
• Kanban and Gantt - visual management and timeline
• Timers - when each partner worked and on what. A running timer = a green ring around their photo above
• Shifts - staffing missions that need someone at fixed hours
group.flows:
🔗 Flows
• Processes - things the rikma is pursuing that aren't a mission yet, each with its own conversation
• Chains - every mission and resource across its whole life: from the proposal, through the vote, to the archive
• API - outside systems that send work to the rikma
• Code - the code repositories connected to the rikma
group.money:
💰 Money
• Sales - products and reported sales. Simple product = fixed price, complex product = a price shaped together with the customer. Every product gets its own share page
• Split - the revenue split: everyone gets paid according to what they contributed
• Stipends - one partner funding another partner's living costs while they work
group.opps:
✨ Opportunities
• Incoming wishes - warm leads from concierge customers the rikma is a match for
• Open for partners - the missions and resources the rikma is still looking for
• Resource calendar - what the rikma already holds, and until when
• Demand map - what people around you are looking for and offering
The number on the group = wishes waiting for an answer
group.votes:
🗳️ Votes
• Votes - decisions by agreement, not by majority: approve, talk it through, or make a counter-proposal until everyone signs the same version. Staying silent until the rikma's clock runs out counts as agreeing
• Archive - everything already decided
The number on the group = open votes in the rikma
